name: Squarespace
description_en:
Squarespace is a hosted website platform combining templates and visual page editing with blogging, commerce, client invoices and paid-content tools. Its current Basic, Core, Plus and Advanced plans differ in contributor permissions, customization, platform transaction fees and payment rates. Public publishing requires a paid website subscription; the 14-day trial is not a permanent free plan.

Evaluate the site and its revenue model together. A low subscription can carry higher store or digital-membership fees, and an XML content export does not reproduce the design, store or full application on another host. Domain/email introductions also have renewal and eligibility conditions.
description_zh:
Squarespace 是将模板和可视化页面编辑，与博客、电商、客户发票及付费内容工具组合的托管网站平台。当前 Basic、Core、Plus、Advanced 在贡献者权限、定制、平台交易费和支付费率方面不同。公开发布要求付费网站订阅，14 天试用不是永久免费方案。

应同时评估网站及收入模式。低订阅费可能伴随较高商店或数字会员费用，XML 内容导出不能在其他主机重现设计、商店或完整应用，域名/邮件入门优惠也有续费和资格条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Cloud hosting is included; Fluid Engine editing is identified for version 7.1, with plan-specific contributors and customization.
core_features.explanation_zh: 包含云托管，Fluid Engine 编辑明确对应 7.1，贡献者和定制能力按方案区分。

core_features.explanation_en: Online-store platform fees, digital-content/membership fees, payment processing and automatic tax calculations are distinct charges.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在线商店平台费、数字内容/会员费、支付处理及自动税额计算是不同费用。

core_features.name_zh: 部分 WordPress 格式导出
core_features.explanation_en: Published paid sites can export supported content to XML; layout styles, store pages, drafts and several block types do not export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 已发布付费站可将受支持内容导出 XML，布局样式、商店页面、草稿及多种区块不导出。

pricing.summary_en: Paid site subscriptions after 14-day trial. Captured local pound/VAT page exposes monthly/annual price pairs (Basic £19.20/£14.40, higher tiers more); selected checkout term not confirmed. Platform, digital-content, processing and tax-calculation fees differ.
pricing.summary_zh: 14 天试用后付费；实读地区英镑/VAT 页显示月付/年付价对，Basic £19.20/£14.40，较高档更贵，未确认选中结账周期。平台、数字内容、处理和税额计算费用分开。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Control visibility separately from subscription purchase
sections.title_zh: 将可见性与购买订阅分开控制
sections.en: Use the no-card 14-day trial to prepare pages, navigation and forms. The availability guide distinguishes Private, Password Protected and Public. Private is the default and limits access to owners/contributors with login permissions; a trial can be shared using a site-wide password. To go public, use a paid subscription, open Site Availability, select Public and save. If you built a store, connect the payment processor before accepting orders. Returning to Private stops further indexing but does not instantly erase results already cached by search engines. No site availability or checkout was changed in this research.
sections.zh: 可用免卡 14 天试用准备页面、导航和表单。可见性指南区分 Private、Password Protected、Public；默认 Private，仅有登录权限的所有者/贡献者可访问，试用可用整站密码分享。公开需付费订阅，在 Site Availability 选择 Public 并保存，商店接受订单前还需连接支付商。改回 Private 会阻止进一步索引，但不会立即消除搜索引擎已有缓存结果。本次未更改网站可见性或结账。

sections.title_en: Read local pricing and contributor needs
sections.title_zh: 读取地区定价及贡献者需求
sections.en: The captured page used pound-denominated prices including estimated VAT and exposed both monthly/annual variants: Basic £19.20/£14.40, Core £28.80/£20.40, Plus £43.20/£34.80 and Advanced £106.80/£94.80 per month. The selected rendering/checkout was not independently inspected, so these are local displayed pairs, not a normalized universal quote. Basic allows two contributors; the higher listed plans allow unlimited contributors, with Core+ adding the advertised CSS/JavaScript customization and advanced analytics. Annual domain promotion covers one eligible lowest-tier domain for one year, registered within one year of subscription start; renewal is at standard price plus tax. Eligible higher-plan Google Workspace offers are one new account for year one, excluding domains already using Workspace and additional users.
sections.zh: 实读页使用英镑并含估算 VAT，同时显示月付/年付变体：Basic 每月 £19.20/£14.40、Core £28.80/£20.40、Plus £43.20/£34.80、Advanced £106.80/£94.80。未独立检查选中渲染状态或结账，因此它们是本地区显示价对，不是归一通用报价。Basic 允许两个贡献者，所列更高档不限，Core 及以上增加广告所述 CSS/JavaScript 定制和高级分析。年付域名优惠覆盖一个符合条件的最低价档域名首年，须在订阅开始一年内注册，之后按标准价及税续费。符合条件较高档的 Workspace 优惠仅含一个新账户首年，排除已有 Workspace 的域名和额外用户。

sections.title_en: Budget platform fees, processing and tax separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核算平台费、处理费和税务
sections.en: In the captured table, Basic has a 2% online-store platform fee; Core/Plus/Advanced show 0%. Digital content/membership fees are separately 7%/5%/1%/0% across the four plans. Payment processing still applies: the observed Squarespace Payments card starting rates are 2.0% + £0.25 for Basic/Core, 1.7% + £0.25 for Plus and 1.5% + £0.25 for Advanced. These are plan/region/product-specific starting rates, not a global all-method quote. Automated tax calculations on Core/Plus/Advanced add 0.15%/0.10%/0.05% per transaction, capped at £0.79 in this view. Verify payment-country eligibility and actual product fee category before estimating total cost. A zero platform fee does not mean a zero-cost checkout.
sections.zh: 实读表中 Basic 在线商店平台费为 2%，Core/Plus/Advanced 为 0%。数字内容/会员费独立为四档的 7%/5%/1%/0%。支付处理仍收费：实读 Squarespace Payments 卡片起始费率为 Basic/Core 2.0% + £0.25、Plus 1.7% + £0.25、Advanced 1.5% + £0.25。这是具体方案/地区/产品起价，不是全球所有方式通用报价。Core/Plus/Advanced 自动税额计算另按每笔 0.15%/0.10%/0.05%，此视图上限 £0.79。估算总成本前应核对支付国家及实际商品费用类别，平台费为零不等于结账成本为零。

sections.title_en: Treat XML as a content migration, not a full backup
sections.title_zh: 将 XML 视为内容迁移而非完整备份
sections.en: The October 2026 export guide requires an active published Public site and excludes trials. Open Import & export content → Export → WordPress, select one primary blog if needed and download XML after processing. Supported output includes layout pages, text/image blocks and one blog with up to 1,000 comments per post. Store/portfolio and other page types, multiple blogs, drafts, style settings, custom CSS, audio/video/product blocks and page-specific header/footer content are excluded. It cannot be imported into another Squarespace site as a supported site-transfer workflow. Plan separate migration of products, domains, customer records and any service not included in XML.
sections.zh: 2026 年 10 月导出指南要求有效、已发布且 Public 的网站，排除试用。进入 Import & export content → Export → WordPress，按需选择一个主博客，处理后下载 XML。支持布局页、文字/图片区块及一个博客，每篇最多 1,000 评论。商店/作品集等页面、多个博客、草稿、样式、自定义 CSS、音频/视频/商品区块及页面专属头尾内容被排除。它不是可导入另一 Squarespace 网站的受支持站点转移流程。商品、域名、客户记录及 XML 未包含服务需另行规划迁移。

sections.title_zh: 取消前确认图片独立性
sections.en: The same guide warns that a self-hosted WordPress Importer migration may retain image reference links rather than copying images; they can break when the Squarespace site is cancelled. Its suggested paths are verifying copied images in WordPress.com Media Library or manually downloading/uploading them when using the importer. Confirm destination media and links before ending the old subscription. Pricing says cancelled service continues through the paid period, but these sources do not establish a general unused-time refund or complete retention guarantee. Squarespace suits teams accepting managed templates and platform commerce; self-hosted source ownership or full application portability is not established. No editor, transaction, import, image copying or cancellation was executed.
sections.zh: 同一指南提醒，自托管 WordPress Importer 迁移可能只保留图片引用而未复制，取消 Squarespace 后会断图。指南建议在 WordPress.com Media Library 确认图片已复制，或使用 importer 时手动下载/上传图片。结束旧订阅前应核对目标媒体及链接。定价称取消后服务持续到已付费期结束，但这些来源未确立普遍剩余时间退款或完整保留保证。接受托管模板和平台电商的团队可考虑 Squarespace，未确立自托管源码所有权或完整应用可迁移性。本次未执行编辑器、交易、导入、图片复制或取消。
